description: Hooks for the no-code-method plugin. SessionStart injects the universal behavioural rules at session start (and on resume/clear/compact). PreToolUse runs four checks on Edit/Write/MultiEdit (locked-doc read-only, Serves-line resolution, batch file-list boundary, read-before-edit gate) and one check on Task (test-confirmation gate on no-code-method:batch-executor invocations — V27), plus a git safety guard on Bash (blocks git reset --hard and git push --force — V34). PostToolUse validates BACKLOG.md format after every edit by running the parser and warning immediately if the structure is broken (V46). Stop redirects Claude either to the after-build subagent when a batch has just finished, or back into the top unticked build batch in BACKLOG.md (auto-continuation; respects `stop_hook_active` for one-redirect-per-turn).
